evidence.observation: 2.90 Torr at start of growth, in line with the ramp baseline of about 2.93-2.96 Torr
Rose steadily to 3.224 Torr (+0.32 Torr, about 11%), and the rise is speeding up
Argon flow steady at about 100 sccm, so extra gas flow does not explain the rise
Temperature holds 750 °C with heater power stable at about 46%, so the thermal side looks normal
No oxygen sensor installed, so a leak can't be told apart from an exhaust blockage

args.missing_evidence: No oxygen reading at the exhaust. A discriminating test would settle it: a leak-up test (isolate the pump and measure how fast pressure rises) or a check of exhaust line and pump conductance. Either would separate a seal leak from an exhaust blockage.
